an orthophoto at <= 0.5 m/px (12 m = 24 px)

generated_by: manual record: readings from Street View panos, written by hand because a human reading cannot be regenerated
label: Espoo Kurttila mast (event-free control)
licence: Street View imagery is NOT stored in this repository. Only the reading, the pano ids and their metadata are recorded; the Maps Platform terms forbid storing the imagery itself.

adopted.evidence: equals OSM node 2233589804 to 0.0 m (height=36, man_made=mast, tower:construction=lattice, tower:type=communication) and is the coordinate the site's own reference uses (espoo_phase_stationarity.json)

mast_position.consequence: none for the numbers: Espoo has no mask layer, so no chip and no OCV value depends on the asset point. If it ever gets one, this must be settled first.

decision.effect: none on any number - Espoo has no mask layer. It fixes the asset point for any future work: the OSM node, not a map click.
decision.why: OSM node 2233589804 carries the height the record documents (36 m) and the lattice/communication tags, and it is the coordinate the site's SAR reference already uses; the reported alternatives are 50.7 m and 3 869.8 m away and carry no evidence.

reported_alternatives.reason: no corroboration: Overpass was unavailable (502 / timeout), so whether a second mast node exists there is unchecked. 50.7 m is inside a telecom site and may well be another antenna, but the SAR record anchors on the OSM node.
3.87 km from the site the SAR record measured. Kurttila is fixed by that record, so a point 3.9 km away cannot be the same asset.

settles: an Overpass query at the reported point when the API is back
an orthophoto at <= 0.5 m/px showing both structures
the site project's own asset record, if it names a node

not_claimed: The height was confirmed qualitatively, not measured.
base_width_m is still the registry default and is marked unconfirmed.
The mast coordinate is not verified against the panorama.
Nothing here makes Espoo migratable: it has no mask layer.

position_check.consequence: none for the numbers: Espoo has no mask layer and no chip. If it ever gets one, the OSM node is the anchor, not a structure identified by eye in a panorama.
position_check.observed: the reviewer reports the mast on the right of the frame at yaw 97.46 deg, elevation plausible
position_check.why: the repository point equals OSM node 2233589804 to 0.0 m, and that node carries height=36 m, so the OSM mast sits 26.4 deg LEFT of centre in that frame. What is on the right is another antenna on the same telecom site, not the asset. Only the OSM node is measured.
